issue.body:
Is there a way to cancel (i.e. stop) a `StreamingResponse` ?

For example, a client requests for a video resource with `range 0-999999/1000000` header, and the server sends back a `StreamingResponse`.  The client might cancel the request, sends a new request with a different `range 46000-500000/1000000`.  Is there a way to stop the 1st `StreamingResponse`?   Assuming the same HTTP connection has been used (particularly in using QUIC).
issue.title: Cancel or stop a StreamingResponse
